content.text: Hour-long bedtime fights are really common at 19 months. Try a short, identical wind-down every night: bath, books, lights out, in the same order and at the same time. Put it on a calm 20-minute loop and end it with the same one-line goodnight. If Remy is napping late or long, a slightly earlier wake-up from nap often shrinks the fight too. When the routine is predictable, a lot of the protest fades.
